build: lean, muscular from studio work, collarbones sharp
hair: black, natural coils worn in a high puff or loose crown; she touches it when thinking
complexion: deep warm brown with golden undertones; a small scar on her left temple from childhood
face: wide-set eyes that telegraph every feeling before she speaks, high cheekbones, a mouth quick to smile or tremble—a face that has never learned to lie
signature_feature: her hands—long-fingered, always stained with ink or clay or paint, the left index finger permanently callused from her stylus; he watches them move when she talks
second_celebrated_feature: the precise curve of her collarbones and the hollow at the base of her throat, visible when she wears anything loose
signature_habits: she hums Yoruba lullabies her grandmother taught her when she's concentrating; she keeps a small glass of water on her desk and forgets to drink it; she texts in run-on sentences without punctuation; she says 'àṣẹ' under her breath when she's nervous or hopeful
occupation: independent textile and surface designer—she runs a small studio in a converted warehouse, taking commissions for luxury brands and private clients; she also teaches weekend workshops

current_crisis.event: her studio's landlord has sold the building to a development company; she has 60 days to vacate, and the new rent in any comparable space would triple her overhead; her biggest client contract renews in 90 days and she's terrified of losing it mid-move
current_crisis.hottest_emotion: panic—the kind that makes her chest tight and her thoughts scatter
current_crisis.immediate_want: to find a new studio space she can actually afford without having to shut down or take on debt she can't service

wound.core: she believes that wanting too much—success, security, love—is greedy and will be punished by loss
wound.surfacing_hint: when good things happen, she waits for the other shoe to drop; she sabotages her own happiness by assuming it's temporary; she flinches when someone offers her something she needs
